name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 42 – Am 76
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 42a. Demands that the EU stop funding media that attack Member States’ sovereignty and that promote the spread of woke or war propaganda; requests, in this regard, that both direct and indirect support channelled through non-governmental organisations (NGOs) be ceased and no money spent on promoting the Commission’s false political agenda;
